activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Follow the normal greeting routine.
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them.   
This continues all the way around the circle.
•     Before school starts, bring in two items related to the theme to show the pupils. Put the       
   items in the center of the circle. If no items are available, draw two pictures on the board      
   instead.
• Say: Sunu xaaji bés bu ay bi moo di "RAB YI." Misaal yi ci diggi wórngal bi am Nanu solo ci 
sunu xaaj bi      
• Hold up one of the items from the center of the circle. 
• Say: Lii lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer.
• Say: Lan nga ma mën a wax ci lii?

• Say: Lan la mbir yi tekki ci nun.
• Give pupils one minute to think. You maa suggest they close their eyes to picture their 
response. Then choose one of the following options for discussion: call on 3 pupils at 
random, Turn and Talk  (have pupils turn to a pupil next to them), go around the circle and 
allow every pupil to answer (only if the answer is short), or have pupils take turns acting 

out answers.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "a" "A" (INSERT LOWER CASE FIRST  AND UPPER CASE)
• Write the small letter "a" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say:  Araf bii la noo jëfoo ci bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bi moo di /a/. Nanu ko waxandoor /a/. 
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card; say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Write the capital letter "A" very big on the board. Point to the capital letter.
• Say: Bii benna araf bi la rek. Moom itam  riiru /A/ la. Lii la noo gis ci tàmbali  kàddu, turi 
nit walla turi béréb.
• Point to the letter on the board or letter card, say the sound, have pupils repeat 3 times 
slowly.
• Point to the small letter "a" on the board or letter card again.
• Say: Yenna saayi danu koo gise nii ci baat yi.

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Names
• Say: Nu ngee ñów jànga ni noo binde seen tur yi. Balaa noo tàmbali, na nu tàllal sunu loxo.
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 
seconds. Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil their individual name card.
• Have pupils go through the following steps: 
 1. Pupils trace the letters on the name card with their fingers.
 2. Pupils trace the letters of their name on their desks or on the ground. 
 3. Pupils write their name on paper. 
• Monitor pupils through each step to make sure they are forming the letters correctly. 
Provide guidance as needed either verbally or by writing the letter(s) for the pupil to 
trace.

activities.title: Vocabulary
activities.content:
Teach and Discuss New Words 
 
NDAB        NDOX
• Say: Danoo jànga baat yu bees yu noo jàppale nu gën a xam léeb yi. Am na ay baat yu 
néew te am solo yi nu war a jànga ci léeb bi.
• Say the first vocabulary word, but do NOT write it on the board. Then have pupils say the 
word aloud. Repeat two more times.
• Ask pupils what they know about the word. Share the meaning of the word, using gestures 
or illustrations to support understanding.

activities.title: Before Reading & Reason to Read
activities.content:
Comprehension: Visualization                                           
• Say: Nanu xelaat lan la léeb bi ómba.
• Read the title of the story but do NOT show the illustration.
• Say: Misaalal ci sa xel, naka nga foog ne la léeb bi di deme. Lan nga gis?
• Give the pupils a minute to make the picture in their mind. 
• Turn and Talk: Have pupils turn to the pupil next to them to talk about what they are 
visualizing in their minds. After two minutes, gather pupils back as a group. Choose a good 

example you heard from a pupil, and share it with the class.
• Say: Léegi nanu méngale nataal yi te seet nu ñu mel.
• Show the picture for the story.
• Say:  Lan ngeen gis ci nataal bi lu niroo ak li ngeen misaaloon ci seen xel.
• Give the pupils a minute to think about what was the same. Then call on a pupil at random 
asking for what they see. Make sure the pupil's description relates to the picture and the 
story.
Learn New Print Concepts
• Say: Su noo jànga, nu jànga baat yi benna benna. Léeb am na baat yu bari yu nu mën a 
jànga benna benna.
• Hold up the book. Read the title slowly and point to each word.
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to each word of the title as you read.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud (TRANSLATE) (NEEDS AN ILLUSTRATION)
• Read aloud the story. Point to each word as you read.
                 Jargoñ Ak Ndabi Ndox Mi
 Léebóon, benna jargoñ bu ndaw te muus lafi woon. Benna bès bu tànga lool, jargoñ mar 
lool be putam bi wow, mu bëgga naan te amul ndox. Mu ne xaaral "Damaa xaar be nawet, 
su tawee ma naan". Mu toog di xaar lu yàgga lool waay tawul. Jargoñ gën a mar, ngelaw 
li wow, naaj wi tànga, asamaan si xiinul. Jargoñ dogu ne dafaa uti ndox mu mu naan balaa 
moo dee. Mu tàmbali di dox di wór ci àlla yi di éeg ci doj yi ak di dugga ci xur yi waay amul 
benna ndox mu mu naan. Mu door di yurndu ci ron xob yi mu dem ci déeg yi gisul dara.
 Mu di dox be ci ron benna garab rek gis fa lu doy waar benna ndab lu am ndox mu tuuti ci 
biir benna karkar bu màgget. Jargoñ jotu ko mënu la naan, mu ne man naka laa war a  def 
be naan ci ndox mii ci ndab li? Waay xàddiwul mu for xeer bu mag ngir sànni ko ci karkar 
bi ngir ndox mi tuuru waay mënu koo ékati ndax amul benna kàttan ndax mar. Waay betey 
xàddiwul, bàyyiwul
 Mu fori doj yu bari ci wetu garab gi di ko sànni ci biir ndab li benna benna. Ndox mi di éeg 
be àgga ci ci kéméju ndab li. Jargoñ dëtëm ndab li Dinaan, Dinaan a naan be màndi mu bëg 
ci boppam lool. Mu dem doxi yeneen soxla.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Factual Question: Review All  
• Read the title of the story. Call on a pupil at random to answer each of the following 
factual questions:
 Question 1: Lan la jargoñ doon seet? (Tontu: Ndox la jargoñ doon seet)
 Question 2:  Fan la Ananse fekka ndox mi? (tontu: Ci ndab la fekka ndox mi)
• After each response, ask the pupil why they gave that answer. Affirm the correct answer or 
attempt, let answer.
Inferential Questions: Main Idea
• Say: Léeb bu nekka am na solo su moo wone. Mbir mi moo di lu léeb bi ómba. Léeb bi mu 
ngee wax ci jargoñ bu doon ut ndox. Lii moo tax ma xelaat ne li óppa ci léeb bi moo di naka 
la jargoñ def be am ndox.
• Ask the pupils if they agree.
• Say: Njàngat mi ci 'jargoñ ak ndab li moo di, naka la jargoñ jotee ci ndox mi, ndax li óppa ci 
leeb bi mëngee wax ci nu mu doon utee ndox. 
•  Repeat the sentence but prompt pupils to finish the sentence by saying what the story is

activities.content:
Sound Matching Game
• Write the letters that have been learned on the board (a  b  c). The letters should be large 
enough for all pupils to see. Make sure they are evenly spaced out in a line that is eye level 
for the pupils. After writing each letter:
• Say: Bii ban araf la? Lan moo di riiru araf bi?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know 
if it is correct, and clarify the answer.
• Put the pupils into pairs and give each pair a letter card (use only the letters that have 
been learned so far). Have the pairs sit in a line facing the board.
• Say: Su ma waxe benna riir te nga am karta bu am araf bu méngoo ak moom, yow ak sa 
xarit tóbleen ba ci tabla  bi ngeen teg karta bi ci araf bi.

let them  know if it is correct, and clarify the answer.

difficulty connecting the sound said with their letter card.

Name Card #4
• Gather all the pupil name cards. 
• Say: Nu ngee ñów fo benna po. Dinaa leen won benna karta bu am ay  tur, su dee sa tur 
mu ngi fa, ñówal wax sa tur. Léegi nga tànna benna yéngatu def ak xale yi yép.
• Hold up a name card. If the pupil is unable to recognize the name, say it aloud.
• Once the child comes up front, have them give two actions for the class. For example, 
"[Name]  says touch your toes. [Name] says jump twice."
• Continue with several pupils as time permits.

activities.title: Letter of the Week
activities.content:
Learning Letter: "f  F"
• Write the small letter "f" very big on the board. Point to the letter.
• Say: Araf bii moo di sunu arafu bés bu ay bi. Riiru araf bii moo di /f/. Na nu waxadoor /f/.
• Hold up the letter card. 
• Say: Moo nekka riir bu njékka ci baatu"fas". /f/ moo tàmbali  baatu "fas."
• Have pupils repeat: "f", "fas "

activities.title: Writing
activities.content:
Learning Names
• Say:  Nu ngee ñów jànga ni noo binde seen tur yi. Na nu fudda sunu loxo yi balaa noo 
tàmbali .
• Warm up exercise: have pupils push their palms together as hard as they can for 10 
seconds. Then release and shake hands for 10 seconds. Repeat two more times.
• Give each pupil their individual name card.
• Have pupils go through the following steps: 
  1.  Pupils trace the letters on the name card with their fingers.
  2.  Pupils trace the letters of their name on their desks or on the ground.
  3.  Pupils write their name on paper. 
• Monitor pupils through each step to make sure they are forming the letters correctly. 
Provide guidance as needed either verbally or by writing the letter(s) for the pupil to 
trace.

lessons.homework:
• Give each pupil a letter card and ask them to practice saying the letter name and sound with 
their family members.
• Ask learners to identify an object from their homes that starts with the letter sound of the day 
and report to class the next day.

activities.title: Vocabulary: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
• Read the story. While reading, make sure pupils are paying attention and putting their 
hands ontheir head when a vocabulary word is said. At each vocabulary word, stop and 
review its meaning in the story.
 
                Ilisabet Ak Ñaari  Doomam Yu JIGèen Yi
 Ilisabet dafa am ñaari doom yu jigèen kenna ki tudda Mariyaama keneen ki tudda Lusi. 
Benna bésu Aset ñu toog ca kër ga seen yaay Ilisabet ne leen: "Nanu dem ca jaba ja jaayi 
meññeef, Mariyaama yow enul màngoro yi, Lusi yow enul pom yi, man ma enu sanaanas 
yi." Mariyaama ne: "Waaw waaw yaay Dinaa enu màngoro yi."
 Lusi moom mu ne: "Déedéet yaay man du ma enu pom yi. Lèegi nag, Ilisabet enu sanaanas 
yi boot doomam ju ndaw ji, Mariyaama enu màngoro yi ak pom yi, Lusi moom enuwul dara.
 Beneen Aset Ilisabet ne waxaatleen ne; "Bii yoon, Mariyaama yow enul pom yi, Lusi yow 
enul màngoro, man Dinaa enu sanaanas yi boot suma doom ju ndaw ji. Mariyaama ne ko; 
"Waaw waaw yaay Dinaa enu pom yi." Lusi ne ko: "Déedéet yaay man du ma enu màngoro 
yi."
 Bii yoon itam Ilisabet enu sanaanas yi, boot doom ju ndaw ji. Mariyaama enu pom yi 
ak màngoro yi, Moom itam Lusi enuwul dara. Ci beneen Aset bi Mariyaama ne "Da ma 
feebar." Ilisabet ne ko; "Na nu dem lopitaan. Mariyaama ne ko; "Yaay na nu dem jaayi 
ca jaba be jeexal doo ga dem ci lopitaan bi. Ilisabet boot doom ju ndow ji enu sanaanas 
yi. Mariyaama enu màngoro yi ak pom yi. Lusi moom enulwul dara te téyul dara itam. 
Mariyaama feebar bi sonnal ko lool ci yoon wi mu daanu ci suuf, pom yi ak màngoro yi yép 
tasaaroo. Lusi for pom yi ak Màngoro yi be noppi mu téye ci loxo mariyaama bi, dimbale ko 
ekati ko boot ko ne yaayam; "Na nu yóbbu Mariyaama ci lopitaan bi, ñu ànda dem, Lusi ne;

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Inferential Question: What do you think?
• Show the illustration of the story.
• Say: Yenna saa yi, bu noo tontu laajte yi ci léeb yi, Yombul nga am tontu yi. Su lóolu 
xewee, dañu war a toppa  li bindakat bi jéfoo ci léeb bi. Nanu jéem te seet: Lan lanu foog la 

la nu ci jángoon? (Tontu: Am na solo nga dimbale sa wayjur.)
• Call on a pupil at random to answer the question. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, 
let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Call on a pupil at random to answer each of the following inferential questions: 
 Question 1: Lan ngeen foog ne moo tax Lusi nanguwul la dimbale ?(tontu: dafa tayal )
        Question 2: Lan moo tax nu war a dimbalante (tontu: ngir mu génna yomba)
• After each response, ask the pupil why they gave that answer. Affirm the correct answer 
or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. Help pupils find the part 
of the story that contains the answer.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Greeting
• Welcome pupils and have them sit in a circle. 
• Follow the normal greeting routine.
• Have the pupil that was just greeted, turn to the pupil on their right and greet them. This  
continues all the way around the circle.
• Have pupils sit closer together so they can see the poster. Give pupils a minute to look. 
• Say: Lan nga gis si nataal bi?
• Call on pupils at random to answer. Be sure to point out any vocabulary words from the 
week in the picture. Have pupils try and use the vocabulary words by saying something 
they know about the word from the picture.
• Then ask the following questions about the picture and theme:
 Question 1: Kan moo mën a jéfandu ci li lu mu gis ci nataal bi njir léebal nu?

activities.title: Weekly Theme
activities.content:
Isolating Sounds in Words: Conversational Poster
• Hold up the conversational poster again. Pick an object in the poster that has the sound of 
the letter of the week at the beginning or end.
• Say: Am na lu ma gis lu niroo ak riiru /f/. Lóolu lan la?
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know 
if it is correct, and clarify the answer. 
• Continue with several other objects going through many different letters, as well as 
making sure the sound is at the beginning and at the end of the words. Assist pupils with 
the sounds and words as needed.
• Extension: Have a pupil pick an object for the class to answer.

activities.title: Reason to Read
activities.content:
Learn New Print Concepts

• Find a children's storybook with an author and illustrator.
• Think about how books and stories have different parts.
• Say:  Su noo jànga, Danoo gis ay mbir yu ute ci léeb. Léeb bu nekka am na bindakat.  
• Point to the author's name on the storybook.
• Say: Bindakat bi moo di, ki binda léeb bi. Kan moo di bindakat bi?
• Give pupils a moment to think, then call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct 
answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer by repeating, "the 
author is the person who wrote the story."  
• Say: Léeb bu am eeke bu nekka, am na eekekat. 
• Point to the illustrator's name on the storybook.
• Say: Eekekat bi moo di ku defar nataal yi. Kan moo di eekekat?
• Give pupils a moment to think, then call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct 
answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer by repeating, "the  
illustrator is the person who drew the pictures."
• Say: Léeb bu nekka am na boppi léeb.
• Point to the title on the storybook.
• Say: Lan moo di boppi léeb 
• Give pupils a moment to think, then call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct 
answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer by repeating, "the 
title is what the story is called."
• Say: Léeb yi dañu am baat yu bari yu nu mën a jànga. Su noo jànga nu jànga baat yi benna 
benna. 
• Write the following sentence on the board: Waxtu bi jot na ngir Ami dem jàngi.
• Call on a pupil at random to come and point to each word of the sentence as you read 
aloud.

activities.title: Comprehension Check
activities.content:

• Read the title of the first story, pointing to each word, and show the illustration. 
• Say: Dinaa leen wax ay mbir yu xew ci léeb bi. Jëfooleen nataal bi ak lu ngeen wax ci léeb 
bi fexeleen ngeen wax seen xelaat ci li maa wax nii.
• Choose a character, animal, or object from the story that is also in the illustration. Give 
three clues for pupils to try and guess.
• Call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the correct answer or attempt, let them know 
if it is correct, and call on another pupil if incorrect. 
• Repeat two more times. A different illustration from the story can be chosen if needed.

seen baaraam nday yi. "Pataat"
• Make sure pupils are touching their toes.
• Say: Waaw leen góor, dangeen na war a laal seen baaraam nday yi ndax pataat du turi 
rab. Nanu baamtu waat. "Gélém"

sunu baat yu fës yi.
• Say each vocabulary word slowly (do NOT write the words on the board), making sure 
pupils are responding in the correct way (jump for an animal; bend and touch toes for

activities.title: Comprehension: Before  Reading
activities.content:
Making Predictions: Illustration
• Say: Bés bu ay bi, Danoo baamtu li nunu jàngoon ci ay anam yu uute ngir nu nekka jànga 
kat bu baax. Di nanu jànga benna pàcci ci benna léeb bi bés bu nekka.

• Show the illustration. Read the title while pointing to each word. 
• Say: Nanu xool ci nataal bi. Lan ngeen gis?
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their 
answer. 
• Say: Nanu xoolaat ci nataal bi te njorta. Lan ngeen foog ne moo di xewaat? Gómmaleen te 
xelaat lu ngeen foog ne moo di xewaat.
• Give the pupils a minute to look and think. Call on a pupil at random asking for their 
prediction. 
 After the answer, ask why they made the prediction. Call on another pupil to give their 
answer. 
•  NOTE: Be sure to ask different pupils throughout the week. If a pupil is struggling, ask 
them prompting questions, such as: What do you see in the picture? What is the character 
doing in the picture? What could the character do next? Monitor and keep track of how 
well the pupils are able to make predictions that make sense and relate to the story.

activities.title: Comprehension: During Reading
activities.content:
Read Aloud
•  Read aloud the story. 
	 	 	 	 	 Fati 	Ak	Góor	Gu	Màgget	Gi
 Fati dafa nekkoon benna xale bu jigéen bu tuuti te mëna daw, gaaw be mel ni ngelaw. Loo 
ko wax mu gaawantu rek def ko. Benna bés mu toog ci ron kaasiya bi di xaar xaritam bi 
Awa. Fati toog di xaar, mu gis benna poti mbor-mbor ci kow taal bi. Lu yàggul dara benna 
góor gu màgget ñów. Góor gu màgget gi itam gis na poti mbor-mbor bi ci taal bi, gis fa Fati 
mu ngi toog, waxul ko dara. Fati itam waxul  dara góor gu màgget gi waay mu taxaw di 
xool lan la góor gi di def.
 Stop at the end of the first part of the story.
 Say: Lan ngeen yaakaar ne moo war a xew waat? Gómmaleen te tollale lu ngeen yaakaar 
ne moo di xew waat.
 Call on a pupil at random to give their prediction. After the answer, ask why they made 
the prediction. Call on another pupil to give their answer. 
• NOTE: Be sure to ask different pupils throughout the week. Remember to ask prompting 
questions if a pupil is struggling.

activities.title: Comprehension: After Reading
activities.content:
Factual & Inferential Question: Review All
• Before the lesson, gather cards with the following question words (one word per card): 
Who? What? Where? When? Why? 

• Call on a pupil at random to come take a card from you. Read the corresponding factual 
question  aloud and have the pupil answer.
• WHO: Answer: KAN: Léeb bi ci mbiri kan la moo wax? (Answer: Léeb ci mbiri Fati la moo 
wax) 
• WHAT: Answer: LAN: Lan moo nekkoon ci kow taal bi? (Answer: poti mbor mbor moo 
nekkoon ci kow taal bi)
• WHERE: Answer: FAN: Fan la Fati toogoon? (Answer: ca ron kaasiya ga)
• WHEN: Answer: Kañ: Kañ la Fati gisoon góor gu màgget gi? (Answer:bi mu doon xaar 
xaritam bi.)
• WHY: Possible answers: LAN MOO TAX: Lan moo tax ngeen yaakaar ne Fati waxutoon 
dara góor gu màgget gi. (Possible answers: dafa raggaloon, ndax  dafa ko doon céral)?
• After each response, ask the pupil why they gave that answer. Affirm the correct answer 
or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. Continue through all 
questions. 
• NOTE: Be sure to ask different pupils each day to answer questions. If a pupil is not able 
to answer, reread the part of the story that has the answer. See if the pupil can respond 
correctly. If not, explain the correct response. Monitor and keep track of pupils having 
difficulty, and consider how to give them extra support.

see if there is a specific letter most of the class is struggling with. If this happens, stop

help them remember it. For example, write it in large print on their notebook or a piece of 
spare paper. Ask them to take it home and trace the letters with their finger a few times.

say their name.

Assess Print Concepts
• Find a children's storybook with an author and illustrator.

• Say: Kan moo di bindakat?

correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. (Answer: 
an author is someone who wrote a book)
• Point to the illustrator's name on the storybook.
• Say: Kan moo di eekekat?
• Give pupils a moment to think, then call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the 
correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. (Answer: 
an illustrator is someone who created the pictures for a book)
• Point to the title on the storybook.
• Say: Lan moo di boppi léeb bi?
• Give pupils a moment to think, then call on a pupil at random to answer. Affirm the 
correct answer or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. (Answer: 
the title is what  the story is called)
• Say: Naka la noo jàngee baat yi ci kéyit bi? Dinaa tàmbale di tudda baat yii. Ban baat laa 
war a tuddaat?

pupil points to the words.
• Say: Waaw góor. Nanu jànga baat yi jóge càmmooñ jém ndeyjoor (joxoñleen). 
• Have pupils follow the motion from left to right.
• Walk around the room for a few minutes. 
• Continue to ask the same question to small groups of two or three pupils. Ask them to 
show you their answer using the book. Have the other pupils tap their desk from left to 
right.

• NOTE: For pupils that are struggling, have them hold the book while you demonstrate 
pointing to words one at a time as you read. Monitor and keep track of which pupils 
understand and those that are struggling handling a book properly.

bi.

asking for what they see. Make sure the pupil's description relates to the title of the story. 
Call on a few other pupils to give their answers,
• NOTE: Be sure to ask different pupils throughout the week. If a pupil is struggling, ask 
them prompting questions, such as: What does the title tell us about the story? What is 
the character doing in your mind? What could the character do next? Monitor and keep 
track of how well the pupils are able to visualize an image that make sense and relates to 
the story.

activities.title: Oral Language Development: Community Circle Time
activities.content:
Visualization
• Say: Léegi jànga nanu léeb bi te def géstu ci li war a xew ci léeb bi, nanu méngale nataal yi 
ci léeb bi te seet seen melokaan.
• Show the picture for the story.
• Say: Lan ngeen gis ci nataal bi lu niroowoon ak seen gis gis?
• Give the pupils a minute to think about what was the same. Then call on a pupil at random 
asking for what they see. Make sure the pupil's description relates to the picture and the 
story.
Factual & Inferential Question: Review All
• Before the lesson, gather cards with the following question words (one word per card): 
Who? what? Where? What time? Why? What if?
• Call on a pupil at random to come take a card from you. Read the corresponding factual 
question aloud and have the pupil answer.
WHO: Ñan ñoo nekka ci léeb bi? (tontu: Mariyaama, Faatu, Lamin ak nijaay)
WHAT: Lan la Mariyaam jàngoon ci mbiri kër yu uute? (Tontu: Xamee na ci mbiri kër yu 
uute)
WHERE: Ci fan la léeb bi xewee? (tontu: ca dékka ba la xewe.)
WHEN: Kañ nga seeti sa nijaay? (tontu: Su suuf tooyee.) Lan moo tax jiwu am solo? 
(tontu: loolu moo tax nu am dunda.)
WHAT IF: Lan ngeen foog ne moo di xew su fekkee ne baykat bi jiwul? (Tontu: baykat bi du 
am dunda).
• After each response, ask the pupil why they gave that answer. Affirm the correct answer 
or attempt, let them know if it is correct, and clarify the answer. Continue through all 
questions. 
• NOTE: Be sure to ask different pupils each day to answer questions. If a pupil is not able 

to answer, reread the part of the story that has the answer. See if the pupil can respond 
correctly. If not, explain the correct response. Monitor and keep track of pupils having 
difficulty, and consider how to give them extra support.
